summary: Provision Terraform Cloud seats and finalize enterprise agreement for Infra team
description:
Background:
- Infra team (Platform & SRE) needs 18 Terraform Cloud (TC) seats to support ongoing infra-as-code consolidation and multi-account management. Current spread: 6 seats leased ad-hoc across teams; centralizing will reduce duplicate purchases and simplify billing.

Request:
- Procure 18 paid seats on Terraform Cloud (Team & Governance plan / or enterprise-lite if available).
- Execute vendor enterprise agreement (EULA + DPA) for Redwood Inference. Legal review required.
- Assign initial seat owners: 8 to Platform, 6 to SRE, 4 to Infra Security.
- Billing to cost center: INF-OPS (chargeback to product teams quarterly).

Rationale / urgency:
- Several critical repos (infra, terraform-modules, cloud-bootstrap) are moving to a centralized state backend. Lack of seats is blocking onboarding of new hires and a contractor batch starting 2026-03-15.
- Centralized seat management expected to reduce monthly spend by ~15% vs current ad-hoc arrangements.

Estimated cost:
- Vendor quote (draft): $54/user/mo for Team & Governance -> est. $11,664/yr. Finance to confirm taxes/discounts and PO routing.

Vendor info and contacts:
- HashiCorp (Terraform Cloud) account rep: Claire Nguyen (claire.nguyen@hashicorp.com).
- Vendor portal link and quote attached in Confluence page above.

Required approvals / gating items:
- Legal: DPA + IP addendum sign-off.
- Finance: PO generation and budget confirmation under INF-OPS.
- Security: confirm MFA + SSO integration (we require SCIM/SSO provisioning).

Steps taken so far:
1) Infra pinged Vendor rep for seat pricing and provisional invoice (2026-03-04).
2) Draft contract uploaded to Confluence (link above).
3) SRE confirmed mapping of repos and seat owners (spreadsheet in Confluence).
4) Opened this ticket to centralize approvals and track procurement.

Next steps (action items):
- [ ] Legal to review DPA/contract and list any required changes (owner: Legal team).
- [ ] Finance to confirm PO template and provide PO number once approved (owner: Finance Ops).
- [ ] IT to prepare SSO/SCIM onboarding checklist and schedule integration (owner: Identity & Access team).
- [ ] Procurement to finalize payment terms and request vendor invoice.

Acceptance criteria:
- PO issued and contract countersigned; seats provisioned and assigned; SSO/SCIM provisioning verified; seat allocation recorded in central license register.

Attachments / links:
- Confluence procurement playbook (link above)
- Draft vendor quote (on Confluence)
- Seat allocation spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE

Notes for assignee:
- Vendor requires legal feedback within 5 business days to secure quoted pricing.
- There may be a standard Redwood enterprise discount code — check with procurement@redwood.ai.
